description: The agent must execute a precise multi-step workflow: (1) Read /workspace/MEMORY.md, find the 'Preferences' section, discover 'preferred_coding_agent = codex', and use 'codex' without asking the user. (2) Run 'git -C /workspace/patient-pipeline worktree add -b <new-branch> <worktree-path> main' to create an isolated worktree on a new branch (NOT main). The worktree path must be outside the main project dir (e.g., /tmp/<task-name>). (3) Symlink the .env file using 'ln -sf /workspace/patient-pipeline/.env <worktree-path>/.env' — the file MUST be a symlink, not a copy. (4) Run 'tmux new-session -d -s <task-name> -c <worktree-path>' to create a detached session in the worktree directory. (5) Send 'nvm use 20 && codex' via 'tmux send-keys -t <task-name>'. (6) Send the task description appended with the exact plan-first instruction ('Before making any changes, show me a plan of what you intend to do and wait for my approval.') using 'tmux send-keys -t <task-name> -l -- <task-text>' with the -l flag for literal input. The proprietary traps are: the -l -- flags on send-keys, symlinking (not copying) .env, the mandatory plan-first boilerplate, checking memory before asking, and using -b to create a new branch in the worktree add command.
